tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md
jq -r '[.value, .labels.source_session[0], .stack_frames[]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{for(i=3;i<=NF;i++) s["'$i]+=$1} END{for(k in s) print s[k]"'"\\t\"k}' | sort -nr | head -80
jq -s '{samples:length, net:(map(.value)|add), positive:(map(select(.value>0)|.value)|add), negative:(map(select(.value<0)|.value)|add), sessions:(map(.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length)}' samples.jsonl"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[]==\"result:repeated\") | [.value,.labels.source_session[0],(.stack_frames|map(select(startswith(\"action:\") or startswith(\"strategy:\") or startswith(\"object:\")))|join(\"|\"))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){p+=$1; ps[$2]=1; pk[$3]+=$1}else{n+=-$1; ns[$2]=1; nk[$3]+=-$1}} END{for(x in ps)pc++;for(x in ns)nc++;print "positive_ops",p,"positive_sessions",pc,"negative_ops",n,"negative_sessions",nc; print "--positive patterns--";for(x in pk)print pk[x],x; print "--negative patterns--";for(x in nk)print nk[x],x}'"' | sort -nr | head -30
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[]==\"result:repeated\") | [.value, (.stack_frames|map(select(startswith(\"action:\")))[0])] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)p[$2]+=$1;else n[$2]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) print k,p[k],n[k]+0,p[k]-(n[k]+0)}'"' | sort -k4,4nr"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[]==\"result:repeated\") | [.value,.labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){p+=$1; ps[$2]=1}else{n+=-$1; ns[$2]=1}} END{for(x in ps)pc++;for(x in ns)nc++;printf "bad_repeated_ops=%d bad_sessions=%d good_repeated_ops=%d good_sessions=%d net_excess=%d ratio=%.3f'"\\n\",p,pc,n,nc,p-n,p/n}'
jq -r '[.value,.labels.source_session[0],(.stack_frames|map(select(startswith(\"result:\")))[0])] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '"'$3=="result:repeated"{if($1>0)p+=$1;else n+=-$1} {if($1>0)tp+=$1;else tn+=-$1} END{printf "bad_repeat_share=%.4f (%d/%d) good_repeat_share=%.4f (%d/%d) share_ratio=%.3f'"\\n\",p/tp,p,tp,n/tn,n,tn,(p/tp)/(n/tn)}'"
